prompt: A cube has a total surface area of $96$ square units. What is the area of **one face**?
hint: The total surface area of a cube is shared equally among its faces. How many equal shares are there?

hints.text: The total surface area of a cube is shared equally among its faces. How many equal shares are there?
A cube has $6$ identical faces, so split the total into $6$ equal parts: work out $96 \div 6$.
$96 \div 6 = 16$, so one face has an area of $16$ square units.

explanation: A cube has $6$ faces that all have the same area.
The total surface area is $6$ times one face, so one face is the total divided by $6$.
Do the division: $96 \div 6 = 16$, which checks because $6 \times 16 = 96$.
The area of one face is $16$ square units.
